No product code was changed: the clean main candidate is exercised with candidate-bound streaming tests and a real Redpanda broker/real Ronin API/Chromium diagnostic, while the family remains in_progress.

security_and_recovery.live_provider: The streaming-only live runner started an isolated Redpanda container and a real Ronin API, seeded valid/poison/oversized streaming definitions, ran the Streaming Studio case, correlated every API event to structured logs and removed the container/network. The summary reports 1/1 browser case, 38/38 correlated API events, 34 OK, 4 expected WARN and 0 ERROR/CRITICAL application logs.
security_and_recovery.negative_paths: The real streaming journey includes bounded invalid/poison/oversized input and recovery assertions in the route test; expected WARN responses are recorded as WARN, not as failures. The exact candidate Python selection also covers source/runtime/health/Bundle and HTTP negative contracts.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: Redpanda/Kafka was exercised as a real local provider. PostgreSQL and the worker image were intentionally not started in streaming-only mode; no external broker, multi-partition fault campaign or full provider matrix is claimed.
security_and_recovery.recovery_scope: The live result proves the bounded Streaming Studio/API scenario and cleanup, but does not establish continuous operation, all partition/backpressure failures, operator rollback or complete P11 qualification.

open_cells: P11 is now in_progress, not qualified: the real Redpanda bounded journey is one provider slice; continuous operation, broader partitions/backpressure/failure recovery, complete Studio/operator evidence and the full family matrix remain open.

The exact candidate browser lane is SKIP because the archive lacks @playwright/test; the live checkout browser run is bound to the clean source SHA 902ddc9acea2d8806ba7fab3538ec900a8effc37 and is not substituted for archive browser packaging evidence.
P13 remains blocked by the external secret-provider and release evidence boundary; P8, P10 and all other families retain their ledger states.
No release gate is closed; release remains NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.
limitations: The exact candidate sandbox has no .git metadata by design; generate_public_v1_status --check therefore remains a candidate SKIP and was not converted into PASS.

The candidate archive intentionally does not package browser dependencies; live provider/browser evidence ran from the clean checkout at the exact candidate source SHA with hash-locked dependency caches.
D31 changed no product code; it strengthens integration and reproducibility evidence for an existing P11 path.
No hosted workflow or GitHub Actions evidence was used.
